title: Invalid Memory Orderings on Stores and Loads
prompt: What happens if you pass `Ordering::Acquire` to an atomic store or `Ordering::Release` to an atomic load?
answer: The operation will panic at runtime. `Acquire` is only valid for load or read-modify-write operations, while `Release` is only valid for store or read-modify-write operations. Using the wrong ordering breaks the underlying CPU hardware synchronization contract.
